audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Ryze Level 1 and 'Skill' at Level 2 and Level 6, while the packet chart, the 50% win rate and this page's own whys[0]/[1] all describe Garen owning the early levels.
audit.why: The mirror audit settled it: Garen wins Level 1 through First item, Ryze takes over at two-plus items.
audit.corrected: Garen / Garen / Garen / Garen / Garen / Garen / Ryze, with ratings lowered to match, proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.why: Rod of Ages is the HP fix and Seraph's at two items is the real flip; Realm Warp at 6 is macro-only and the mid paragraph already says so explicitly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Courage's cooldown was quoted as 21 seconds in three places, and neither Demacian Justice's true-damage execute nor Decisive Strike's auto-attack reset appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Courage is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12 — 22s at rank 1, not 21. Demacian Justice deals true damage on an execute threshold, so stacking MR does nothing. Decisive Strike is an auto-reset, so the wind-up is the step-back cue rather than the cast.
audit.corrected: Real 22s rank-1 cooldown, the execute threshold stated as an HP number to stay above, and the auto-reset named as the tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Courage cooldown misquoted, which is the exact number the page tells the player to count.
audit.why: Advice keyed to a wrong number is worse than no number.
audit.corrected: 22 seconds at rank 1, scaling to 12 at rank 5.

edits.after: Courage's active shield and damage reduction cover the exact window you need to land full E-Q-W damage, and at level 3 your mana costs are high enough that wasting a rotation into it is a net loss — wait out its 22-second rank-1 cooldown.

edits.before: Bait Courage's active before committing your full rotation — his W has a 21-second cooldown and your burst only lands clean into that window
edits.after: Bait Courage's active before committing your full rotation — his W is 22 seconds at rank 1 and your burst only lands clean into that window

edits.before: Levels 4 through 5 are a controlled grind — Garen's Courage still cuts your rotation if he reads it early, and his passive regen means every trade that doesn't kill him gets undone in six seconds of backing off. Your job is to track Courage's 21-second cooldown like a sixth ability: the window immediately after it expires is your only honest trade window pre-item. At level 6 Realm Warp adds a real threat — Garen cannot follow a warp and cannot match your roam speed, so threatening the portal down lane forces him to either freeze and lose plates or follow and get ganked. The Warp does not spike your 1v1 DPS, so do not fight him more aggressively at 6 than at 5; use R for map pressure, not as a combat tool.
